## Service Policies
1. **100% Pay On Arrival Policy**:
   - Guests never enter credit card numbers or make bank transfers upfront.
   - Payment is settled upon vehicle arrival at the hotel or camp directly in Cash (AED, USD, EUR, GBP) or Card (Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay).
2. **Cancellation & Rescheduling**:
   - Free 100% cancellation up to 12 hours prior to scheduled departure.
   - Instant date modification via WhatsApp with zero penalty.
3. **Pickup & Return Boundaries**:
   - Free doorstep 4x4 pickup is included for all hotels, residences, apartments, and private villas in Dubai and Sharjah:
     - Downtown Dubai & Business Bay
     - Dubai Marina & JBR (Jumeirah Beach Residence)
     - Palm Jumeirah & Bluewaters Island
     - Deira, Bur Dubai & Al Barsha
     - Dubai Creek Harbour, Festival City & Mirdif
     - Sharjah Central & Al Majaz

## Detailed Tour Catalog & Itineraries

### 1. Evening Desert Safari Dubai (Signature Red Dunes)
- **URL**: https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/evening-desert-safari
- **Rate**: AED 120 / Adult | AED 85 / Child (Ages 3–9) | Free for Infants under 3
- **Duration**: ~7 Hours (02:30 PM Pickup – 09:30 PM Drop-off)
- **Vehicle**: 2026 Toyota Land Cruiser 4x4 (6 passengers per vehicle max)
- **Inclusions**:
  - Doorstep 4x4 hotel pickup and drop-off
  - 45 minutes of extreme red dune bashing in Lahbab
  - Sunset photo stop on high ridge
  - Sandboarding on high dunes
  - Short camel ride experience
  - Bedouin camp entry with Arabic coffee (Gahwa), fresh dates, and henna painting
  - Live entertainment: Tanoura dervish, Fire dancer show, Belly dance
  - 5-Star Live BBQ dinner buffet (Chicken tikka, seekh kebabs, biryani, salads, vegetarian curries, hummus, fresh fruits)
  - Unlimited mineral water, soft drinks, tea, and coffee

### 2. Can-Am Maverick X3 & Polaris RZR Dune Buggy
- **URL**: https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/dune-buggy-dubai
- **Rate**: From AED 1000 / Buggy (2-Seater & 4-Seater options)
- **Duration**: 1 Hour Driving + Transfers
- **Requirements**: No driving license required. Minimum age to drive is 16.
- **Inclusions**:
  - Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo 1000cc or Polaris RZR buggy
  - Full roll-cage, 4-point racing harness, helmet, and goggles
  - Professional desert marshal lead guide on separate vehicle
  - Fuel, safety orientation, and chilled soft drinks
  - Hotel pickup and return included

### 3. Yamaha Quad Bike ATV Desert Safari
- **URL**: https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/quad-biking-dubai
- **Rate**: From AED 150 / Quad Bike (250cc & 350cc automatic ATVs)
- **Duration**: 30 to 60 minute riding sessions
- **Requirements**: No driving license required. Minimum age 14.
- **Inclusions**:
  - Automatic Yamaha four-wheel quad bike
  - Open desert dunes or designated enclosed desert circuit
  - Helmet, goggles, safety orientation, and trail guide
  - Cold refreshments

### 4. Royal VIP Private Desert Safari
- **URL**: https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/private-vip-safari
- **Rate**: AED 850 / Vehicle (Up to 6 guests private)
- **Vehicle**: Exclusive Toyota Land Cruiser 300 Series
- **Inclusions**:
  - Dedicated private master desert marshal
  - Tailored dune bashing intensity (gentle scenic cruise or extreme thrill)
  - Chilled sparkling date juice & private sunset stop
  - Reserved VIP table inside private air-cooled majlis tent
  - Dedicated waiter table service (skip buffet lines)
  - Private falconry photo session

### 5. Abu Dhabi Grand Mosque & City Highlights
- **URL**: https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/abu-dhabi-city-tour-ferrari-world
- **Rate**: AED 150 / Adult | AED 120 / Child

## Frequently Asked Questions & Official Answers

**Q: Do I need to pay any advance deposit or provide credit card information?**
A: No. We operate on a 100% Pay on Arrival model. You can reserve directly via WhatsApp or online without entering payment details. You pay directly upon pickup.

**Q: Is dune bashing safe for children and pregnant women?**
A: Pregnant women are advised not to participate in high dune bashing. For families with infants or elderly guests, we offer gentle direct transfers to the desert camp or private vehicle charters where the driver adjusts the driving style completely to your comfort.

**Q: Do I need a driving license for quad biking or buggies?**
A: No driving license is required. All off-road machines operate in desert dunes with guided escorts and full safety gear.

**Q: What is the dress code?**
A: Casual, loose cotton clothing, shorts, t-shirts, and flat sandals or sneakers. Bring a light jacket or scarf during winter months (November to March).

**Q: Are vegetarian and Halal foods available?**
A: Yes, 100% of our food is certified Halal, and our buffet features dedicated vegetarian and vegan dishes including hummus, tabbouleh, fattoush, falafel, lentil curries, and grilled vegetables.
